title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十一章、大殿问案

    楚珠和八王爷都出现了。包拯很激动，他请楚珠把当年的事情都告诉他，但是八王爷好像不太急。
    “包拯，不急，事情会说清楚的。”八王爷说，他走到担架前，表情沉重地看着担架上的蓝香，问道：“楚珠，她就是蓝香吗？”
    楚珠的眼泪早就掉下来了。她红着眼睛，忍着悲伤，轻轻点了点头。
    八王爷将地上的黑布捡起，轻轻地给蓝香盖上了。然后他转过身，对现场的侍卫们命令道：“现在，把张怀抓起来。”侍卫们不敢说什么，马上把早已吓得说不出话来的张怀抓了起来。
    “包拯，公孙策，楚珠。”八王爷看向三人，再说：“你们和我进宫，一起去把事情说清楚。”
    天还没有亮，但皇宫里已经灯火大亮。这一晚，好像所有人都没有睡。
    大殿上，皇帝高坐在龙椅上，太后坐在旁边，下面站着八王爷、包拯、楚珠、公孙策、张怀和其他一些官员。
    地上放着一面白旗，是包拯挂在菜市场大门上的那面白旗。所有人的目光都被旗上的“狸猫换太子”五个大字吸引住，只有皇帝一人眼含泪光看着八王爷。
    “这是怎么回事？我……很担心你。”皇帝说。
    “对不起，皇上，是我错了。”八王爷的眼睛也红了，他说：“请您听包拯说一说，他会告诉您发生了什么。”
    皇帝的目光这才转到白旗上，他望着那五个大字，问：“包拯，这是什么意思？”
    包拯站出来，问道：“皇上，您知道先皇以前有个叫李妃的贵妃吗？”
    “你是说二十多年前被打入冷宫，后死于火灾的那位李贵妃吗？我听说过。”
    “您知道她为什么会被先皇打入冷宫吗？”
    “听说她是罪人。”
    “她有什么罪呢？”
    “好像是……她生了一个怪物。”
    “怪物？是一只狸猫吗？”
    皇帝的眼睛里有亮光，他看着包拯，好像明白了他的意思。
    “包拯，把你知道的都说出来。”皇帝命令道。
    “好的，皇上，但我想请一个人来说。”包拯退后一步，将中间的位置让给了身边的楚珠。他面向楚珠，问道：“楚珠，你以前是宫女吗？”
    楚珠回答：“二十一年前，我是李妃娘娘宫里的宫女。”
    “娘娘生产的时候，你在宫里吗？”
    “我在。从娘娘怀孕，到娘娘生产，我一直都在娘娘身边。”
    “娘娘生下的是狸猫吗？”
    “不是，娘娘生下的是一个健康的男孩。”
    大殿里一片安静，没有人出声，但每个人的心里都有江海在翻滚。
fullText.traditional:
第三十一章、大殿問案

    楚珠和八王爺都出現了。包拯很激動，他請楚珠把當年的事情都告訴他，但是八王爺好像不太急。
    “包拯，不急，事情會說清楚的。”八王爺說，他走到擔架前，表情沉重地看著擔架上的藍香，問道：“楚珠，她就是藍香嗎？”
    楚珠的眼淚早就掉下來了。她紅著眼睛，忍著悲傷，輕輕點了點頭。
    八王爺將地上的黑布撿起，輕輕地給藍香蓋上了。然後他轉過身，對現場的侍衛們命令道：“現在，把張懷抓起來。”侍衛們不敢說什麼，馬上把早已嚇得說不出話來的張懷抓了起來。
    “包拯，公孫策，楚珠。”八王爺看向三人，再說：“你們和我進宮，一起去把事情說清楚。”
    天還沒有亮，但皇宮裡已經燈火大亮。這一晚，好像所有人都沒有睡。
    大殿上，皇帝高坐在龍椅上，太后坐在旁邊，下面站著八王爺、包拯、楚珠、公孫策、張懷和其他一些官員。
    地上放著一面白旗，是包拯掛在菜市場大門上的那面白旗。所有人的目光都被旗上的“狸貓換太子”五個大字吸引住，只有皇帝一人眼含淚光看著八王爺。
    “這是怎麼回事？我……很擔心你。”皇帝說。
    “對不起，皇上，是我錯了。”八王爺的眼睛也紅了，他說：“請您聽包拯說一說，他會告訴您發生了什麼。”
    皇帝的目光這才轉到白旗上，他望著那五個大字，問：“包拯，這是什麼意思？”
    包拯站出來，問道：“皇上，您知道先皇以前有個叫李妃的貴妃嗎？”
    “你是說二十多年前被打入冷宮，後死於火災的那位李貴妃嗎？我聽說過。”
    “您知道她為什麼會被先皇打入冷宮嗎？”
    “聽說她是罪人。”
    “她有什麼罪呢？”
    “好像是……她生了一個怪物。”
    “怪物？是一隻狸貓嗎？”
    皇帝的眼睛裡有亮光，他看著包拯，好像明白了他的意思。
    “包拯，把你知道的都說出來。”皇帝命令道。
    “好的，皇上，但我想請一個人來說。”包拯退後一步，將中間的位置讓給了身邊的楚珠。他面嚮楚珠，問道：“楚珠，你以前是宮女嗎？”
    楚珠回答：“二十一年前，我是李妃娘娘宮裡的宮女。”
    “娘娘生產的時候，你在宮裡嗎？”
    “我在。從娘娘懷孕，到娘娘生產，我一直都在娘娘身邊。”
    “娘娘生下的是狸貓嗎？”
    “不是，娘娘生下的是一個健康的男孩。”
    大殿裡一片安靜，沒有人出聲，但每個人的心裡都有江海在翻滾。

sentences.pinyin: chǔ zhū huí dá èr shí yī nián qián wǒ shì lǐ fēi niáng niang gōng lǐ de gōng nǚ
sentences.english: Chu Zhu replied, “Twenty-one years ago, I was a palace maid in Consort Li’s palace.”

sentences.simplified: “娘娘生产的时候，你在宫里吗？”
sentences.traditional: “娘娘生產的時候，你在宮裡嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: niáng niang shēng chǎn de shí hou nǐ zài gōng lǐ ma
sentences.english: “Were you in the palace when the noble consort gave birth?”

sentences.simplified: “我在。从娘娘怀孕，到娘娘生产，我一直都在娘娘身边。”
sentences.traditional: “我在。從娘娘懷孕，到娘娘生產，我一直都在娘娘身邊。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài cóng niáng niang huái yùn dào niáng niang shēng chǎn wǒ yì zhí dōu zài niáng niang shēn biān
sentences.english: “I was. From the time when the noble consort was pregnant, to the time she gave birth, I was always by her side.”

sentences.pinyin: niáng niang shēng xià de shì lí māo ma
sentences.english: “Did the noble consort give birth to a leopard cat?”

sentences.simplified: “不是，娘娘生下的是一个健康的男孩。”
sentences.traditional: “不是，娘娘生下的是一個健康的男孩。”
sentences.pinyin: bú shì niáng niang shēng xià de shì yí ge jiàn kāng de nán hái
sentences.english: “No, the noble consort gave birth to a healthy boy.”

sentences.simplified: 大殿里一片安静，没有人出声，但每个人的心里都有江海在翻滚。
sentences.traditional: 大殿裡一片安靜，沒有人出聲，但每個人的心裡都有江海在翻滾。
sentences.pinyin: dà diàn lǐ yí piàn ān jìng méi yǒu rén chū shēng dàn měi ge rén de xīn lǐ dōu yǒu jiāng hǎi zài fān gǔn
sentences.english: The audience hall was silent. No one spoke, but inside, everyone felt as if a storm was raging.

sentence_translations: Chapter 31: Interrogation in the Audience Hall
Chu Zhu and the Eighth Prince had both appeared.
Bao Zheng was very excited.
He asked Chu Zhu to tell him everything that had happened that year, but the Eighth Prince seemed to not be in a hurry.
“Bao Zheng, there’s no rush, everything will be explained clearly,” the Eighth Prince said.
He walked up to the stretcher, looked at Lan Xiang on the stretcher with a grave expression, and asked, ..
.. “Chu Zhu, is this Lan Xiang?”
Chu Zhu’s tears had already started falling. Her eyes were red, and holding back her sadness, she gently nodded.
The Eighth Prince picked up the black cloth on the ground and gently covered Lan Xiang with it.
Then he turned around and ordered the guards that were present, “Now, arrest Zhang Huai.”
The guards didn’t dare to say anything. They immediately arrested Zhang Huai, who was already too frightened to speak.
“Bao Zheng, Gongsun Ce, Chu Zhu.”
The Eighth Prince looked at the three of them and then said, “Come with me to the palace to explain everything clearly.”
The sun was not up yet, but the lights in the imperial palace were already shining brightly.
That night, it seemed as if no one had slept.
In the audience hall, the emperor sat high on the dragon throne, with the empress dowager seated beside him.
Standing below were the Eighth Prince, Bao Zheng, Chu Zhu, Gongsun Ce, Zhang Huai, and some other officials.
On the ground lay a white banner, the same white banner that Bao Zheng had hung above the gate of the market.
Everyone’s attention was drawn to the five large characters on the banner that read “exchanging a leopard cat for a prince”.
Only the emperor, with tears in his eyes, looked at the Eighth Prince.
“What happened? I … was very worried about you,” the emperor said.
“I’m sorry, Your Majesty, it was my fault.” The Eighth Prince’s eyes also turned red.
He said, “Please listen to Bao Zheng speak. He will tell you what happened.”
The emperor’s gaze then turned to the white banner.
He looked at those five big characters and asked, “Bao Zheng, what does this mean?”
Bao Zheng stepped forward and asked, “Your Majesty, did you know that the late emperor once had a concubine named Consort Li?”
“Are you referring to Consort Li, who was banished to the Cold Palace over twenty years ago and then later died in a fire?
I’ve heard about her.”
“Do you know why she was banished to the Cold Palace by the late emperor?”
“I heard she was a wrongdoer.”
“What was she guilty of?”
“I think it was that … she gave birth to a monster.”
“A monster? Was it a leopard cat?”
There was a glimmer in the emperor’s eyes as he looked at Bao Zheng, seeming to understand his meaning.
“Bao Zheng, tell me everything you know,” the emperor commanded.
“Very well, Your Majesty, but I would like to invite someone else to speak.”
Bao Zheng took a step back, giving the spot in the middle to Chu Zhu, who was standing beside him.
He turned to Chu Zhu and asked, “Chu Zhu, were you a palace maid in the past?”
Chu Zhu replied, “Twenty-one years ago, I was a palace maid in Consort Li’s palace.”
“Were you in the palace when the noble consort gave birth?”
“I was. From the time when the noble consort was pregnant, to the time she gave birth, I was always by her side.”
“Did the noble consort give birth to a leopard cat?”
“No, the noble consort gave birth to a healthy boy.”
The audience hall was silent. No one spoke, but inside, everyone felt as if a storm was raging.
